mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_id,title,scene,status,last_message_time,message_count,expire_time,create_time FROM ai_conversation WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND deleted=0

SELECT id,owner_id,title,scene,status,last_message_time,message_count,expire_time,create_time FROM ai_conversation WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status=#{status} AND deleted=0 AND title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY last_message_time DESC,id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET last_message_time=NOW(),message_count=#{messageCount},expire_time=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY), update_by=#{ownerId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE ai_conversation SET status=#{status},update_by=#{ownerId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE ai_conversation SET deleted=1,update_by=#{ownerId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE ai_message SET deleted=1,update_by=#{ownerId} WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no),0)+1 FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND deleted=0

SELECT m.id,m.conversation_id,m.role,m.content,m.content_hash,m.call_log_id,m.sequence_no, m.insufficient_evidence,m.status,m.create_time,f.rating AS feedback FROM ai_message m INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id AND c.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND c.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN rag_feedback f ON f.message_id=m.id AND f.operator_id=#{ownerId} AND f.deleted=0 WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.deleted=0 ORDER BY m.sequence_no ASC

SELECT id,conversation_id,role,content,content_hash,call_log_id,sequence_no,insufficient_evidence,status,create_time FROM (SELECT id,conversation_id,role,content,content_hash,call_log_id,sequence_no,insufficient_evidence,status,create_time FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND deleted=0 AND status='SUCCESS' ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}) recent ORDER BY sequence_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_message SET content=#{content},content_hash=#{contentHash},call_log_id=#{callLogId}, insufficient_evidence=#{insufficient},status='SUCCESS' WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE ai_message SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.conversation_id,m.role,m.content,m.content_hash,m.call_log_id,m.sequence_no, m.insufficient_evidence,m.status,m.create_time FROM ai_message m INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.role='ASSISTANT' AND m.deleted=0 AND c.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND c.deleted=0

SELECT id,call_log_id,article_id,article_version,chunk_id,chunk_no,title,heading,snippet, keyword_score,vector_score,final_score,rank_no FROM ai_call_reference WHERE call_log_id=#{callLogId} AND deleted=0 AND cited=1 ORDER BY rank_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_feedback (id,message_id,call_log_id,operator_id,rating,reason_code,comment,create_by,update_by,deleted) VALUES (#{id},#{messageId},#{callLogId},#{operatorId},#{rating},#{reasonCode},#{comment},#{operatorId},#{operatorId},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating=VALUES(rating),reason_code=VALUES(reason_code),comment=VALUES(comment), update_by=VALUES(update_by),update_time=NOW()
